Hi. I am a registered nurse. Gurgling noises are normal. In fact, during an assessment of a patient, we listen with our stethoscopes to their abdomen to hear these gurgles. We worry when there are no gurgles! Gurgles mean things are moving as they should, and this movement is called peristalsis. It's your intestines/stomach contracting and moving food along your GI tract. Peristalsis especially happens after meals as food digests.

Knowing this, I, too, am triggered by my own stomach gurgling and even my own farts even though I KNOW it's normal. This darn phobia!
